title: [GMCP 203.020.06] Operations and evidence: GMCP server authoring SDK and plugin lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-020-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: A stable Susi-shaped authoring SDK builds local MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, subscriptions, MRTR handlers, tasks and extensions with schema derivation, typed context, middleware, testing fixtures and hot reload. Plugins declare permissions and compatibility, initialize transactionally, unload without leaks, preserve no vendor types across the boundary, and ship runnable minimal through production examples. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: Operations and evidence (`GMCP-203-020-06`) ships `GmcpService::ops_snapshot()`, updated production plugin example `06_production_plugin_server`, CLI/API inspection parity (`susi mcp ledger/status/list/tools/call`, `susi extensions status/list/validate/load/unload`), fail-closed startup/config/pack/durable-task validation, bounded SSE telemetry & Bearer redaction, live catalog rollback & compromised host-pack eviction drills, operational runbook `docs/gmcp/contract-203-020.md`, and automated drift detection across all 14 pinned `VC-203-020` authority specs; final `.M` vector mastery sealing ships next in `T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-113`.

Per `docs/gmcp-roadmap.md`, `docs/gmcp/contract-203-020.md`, and zero-UI plan A9, Core ships zero bundled vendor plugin packs (`DEFAULT_PACK_ID = "default"`; curated packs live in Susi Commercial Apps), and `.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-020.jsonl` plus `.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-020.json` stay strictly absent until `T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-113` (`.M` Mastery).

reuse.why: Extended GmcpService directly with ops_snapshot() and bound CLI/MCP inspection, fail-closed config/manifest/task-store validation, bounded W3C traceparent SSE diagnostics, catalog rollback, compromised-pack eviction, and susi mcp ledger --drift --refetched verification onto existing GMCP and susi-config surfaces.
